# Kite

> Game-feel telemetry for coding agents. Kite runs a Godot game with scripted
> inputs, records frame-level telemetry, and produces feel reports (input
> latency, jump arcs, response curves, assist windows) with per-rule
> contract verdicts and numeric distance-to-target. Agents read the report,
> edit movement constants, re-run, and converge on a target feel.

CLI: `npx @jamba-labs/kite` (run | probe | list | init).
MCP server: `npx -y -p @jamba-labs/kite kite-mcp --project .` exposing
kite_run, kite_probe, kite_list_tests, kite_report.

## Docs

- [Agent guide & drop-in snippet](docs/agents.md): the tune loop, MCP setup, closed-form jump math
- [Spec overview](docs/README.md): three layers (telemetry / metrics / contracts), design rules, versioning
- [Telemetry schema](docs/telemetry.md): kite_telemetry 0.1 JSONL, input script format, determinism requirements
- [Metric pack](docs/metrics.md): canonical metric names, units, definitions (2D platformer movement)
- [Feel contracts](docs/feel-contracts.md): rule types, deltas, shipped presets (snappy / floaty / weighty)
- [Report format](docs/report.md): report.json shape and terminal summary
